svg.aria-label: Koshkenbek Dauren — Cybersecurity Engineer, SOC Analyst and Penetration Tester
svg.title: Koshkenbek Dauren — Cybersecurity Engineer, SOC Analyst and Penetration Tester
svg.desc: Security command-center profile banner. PROFILE.EXE shows a dot-matrix portrait, focus areas and a threat-map widget; TERMINAL shows the profile boot log; SYSTEM.INFO lists roles, key focus areas, selected projects (HackShield Play Nexus, PentestAI, OYNA), the tech stack and security tools.
